problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis. When the displacement of $P$ from the origin is $x\,m,$ the velocity is $v\,m/s,$ the magnitude of the acceleration is $kx\,{m/s}^{2},$ where $k$ is a positive constant, and the acceleration is directed toward $O.$ If $P$ has velocity $v=20\,m/s$ at the origin and the particle is at rest when its displacement is $10\,m,$ find the value of $k.$

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Properties of Objects Described as Functions of Displacement
